{{Quote|When the time comes I will defeat my Master and take his place.''"<br />"''Perhaps that time is now.|Darth Zannah explains the Rule of Two to Hetton|<ref name="Rule of Two" />}}
A '''duel''' occurred in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[990 BBY]], between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-aspirant [[Hetton]], his eight [[Sith Minion|servants]], and [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Instigated by Bane's own [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] ensued after Hetton, who had been tricked by Zannah into giving her information regarding the creation of [[Holocron/Legends|Holocrons]], arrived at Bane's camp on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]]&mdash;having been led there by Zannah.

While meditating at his camp, Bane was surprised by the sudden appearance of Hetton's eight [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]]-trained Sith [[Sith assassin/Legends|Shadow Assassins]], each armed with their customary [[Force pike/Legends|Force pikes]]. Though outnumbered, Bane immediately readied for battle as all eight assassins attacked, attempting to overwhelm him with the strength of their numbers. After cutting down three of them, Bane was interrupted by Hetton, who had Darth Zannah at his side. Hetton then charged Bane, with his five remaining assassins doing the same. However, all were subsequently [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the superior might and skill of Darth Bane. Hetton was last to meet his demise, and upon ending his life, Bane attacked Zannah. Before the Dark Lord could kill her for her seeming betrayal, Zannah revealed the truth; she had been using Hetton all along, and from him she had discovered information on creating Holocrons, a secret which had eluded Bane until that moment.

==History==
===Prelude===
{{Quote|And after Bane is dead we will go to Tython?''"<br />"''If that is your wish, Master.|Zannah and Hetton plot against Darth Bane|<ref name="Rule of Two" />}}
While on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] carrying out her mission to instigate rebellions against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]], the first [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the fledgling [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Order of the Sith Lords|Order]] formed in the wake of the [[New Sith Wars]], encountered a [[Sith Minion|Sith aspirant]] known as [[Hetton]], a Serenno nobleman. Over the course of thirty years, the Serenno aristocrat had accumulated a vast collection of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]], and had also become well versed in Sith lore. He even employed eight [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Sith assassin/Legends|Shadow Assassins]] from the [[Sith Academy (Umbara)|Sith academy]] on that world, each equipped with the signature [[Force pike/Legends|Force pikes]] of their order. Upon their first meeting, Hetton recognized Zannah as a Sith, and appealed to her; he would pledge all of his resources to her if she in turn accepted him as her apprentice. Zannah agreed, knowing that in truth she would only use Hetton for his knowledge, which potentially included finding information on the creation of [[Holocron/Legends|Holocrons]]. Her only obstacle was her own [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], Darth Bane, whom she knew would never allow such a diversion from his explicitly defined [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], which stated that there could be no more than two Sith at a time&mdash;a Master and an apprentice. Hetton, however, was convinced that Bane could be defeated. She thus agreed to Hetton's terms while keeping her predetermined betrayal of him secret, and the pair, along with the eight assassins, departed for [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] on board Hetton's ship, the [[Loranda (starship)|''Loranda'']], intent on relieving the Dark Lord of his mantle.<ref name="Rule of Two" />

===The duel===
====The Shadow Assassins====
{{Quote|Zannah was right about you. Today is the day you die, Darth Bane.|Hetton|<ref name="Rule of Two" />}}
Meanwhile, Darth Bane sat pondering his own recent failure at constructing a Holocron at his camp on Ambria, when the parasitic [[orbalisk]] armor he was covered in reacted to an unknown and unseen [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] presence in the immediate vicinity. Bane realized that his senses [[Dim Other's Senses|were all muted]]&mdash;he could neither see nor hear anything around him, or sense anything through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Leaping to his feet, Bane activated his [[Curved-hilt lightsaber/Legends|curved hilt]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as he used his powers to [[Force suppression|dispel]] the tricks confounding his perceptions, previously [[Force cloak|concealed]] from his sight, that Bane immediately recognized as Umbaran Shadow Assassins. The loss of stealth slightly disoriented the assassins, causing them to hesitate, while Bane did not. He leapt forward and [[Sai tok/Legends|bisected]] the first of the assailants, causing the rest of them to swarm him with their Force pikes. Foregoing any sort of defense, Bane's [[Form V/Legends|predominantly offensive]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|fighting style]] was an unexpected tactic for the assassins, and two more were swiftly eviscerated by his lightsaber. The remaining Umbarans fell upon him with reckless abandon, simultaneously electrocuting Bane with several thousand volts through their pikes. Bane's orbalisks could not really withstand such an assault, and he was thus forced to his knees in agony. Instead of pressing the advantage, his stunned foes stood in disbelief that their quarry was neither dead nor defeated, having survived the full brunt of their attack. This brief respite was ample recovery time for Bane, whose anger began to rise as he noticed Zannah standing nearby but doing nothing, the woman flanked by an old black-robed man, who was wielding a green-bladed lightsaber.<ref name="Rule of Two" />

====Hetton's demise====
{{Quote|Zannah! Master! Help me!|Hetton, pleading for assistance|<ref name="Rule of Two" />}}
Issuing his challenge, Hetton charged the Dark Lord head-on, while the assassins attacked from behind. Bane met their advance by thrusting out with the dark side towards the Umbarans with such force, it halted two of them in their tracks as though they had suddenly hit a wall, and hurled another two backwards. The fifth and final assassin fell to Bane's lightsaber. While he was distracted, Hetton conjured a single bolt of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] at Bane, which was absorbed by the Dark Lord's blade. In turn, Bane unleashed his own barrage of lightning, the wrath of which Hetton barely managed to [[Force jump/Legends|elude by leaping aside]]. The remaining four assassins then returned to the fray and assailed Bane once more. In response, he completely embraced the dark side and decimated his enemies, [[Death/Legends|killing]] all the assassins in a final attack. Bane next faced Hetton, and [[Cho mai/Legends|removed his weapon arm]] before [[Shiak|running his own blade through]] the old man's chest.<ref name="Rule of Two" />

===Aftermath===
{{Quote|I knew you had the strength to defeat them, Master. That is why I didn't come to your aid during the battle.''"<br />"''And what if you were wrong? What if they had somehow killed me?''"<br />"''Then you would have been weak, unworthy of being Dark Lord of the Sith. And you would have deserved to die.''"<br />"''Precisely.|Darth Zannah and Darth Bane, after the battle|<ref name="Rule of Two" />}}
Outraged at the apparent betrayal of his apprentice, Bane attacked Zannah with a ferocity that she had never before seen in him. The master Sith used a Force push that would have snapped Zannah's bones if she was not able to raise a Force wall and he lashed at her with blade and boot. She attempted to [[Form III/Legends|defend]] herself from his onslaught, all the while pleading her innocence and the discovery of a hoard of Sith information. The Dark Lord sought penance from her, and had beaten her to nigh-oblivion when Zannah finally revealed that she had used Hetton, and acquired from him information on creating Holocrons. Bane ceased his assault upon hearing this, as Zannah presented him with the [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] Hetton gave her as evidence. Finally reassured of Zannah's loyalty, Bane regarded his apprentice's cunning as he considered the implications of the data she presented. When asked what she would have thought had Hetton and his ilk been successful in defeating him, Zannah replied that he would have rightfully earned his death with his weakness, being unworthy to bear the mantle of Dark Lord of the Sith. Bane nodded in approval, content that through Zannah's action, his Sith Order had remained completely anonymous, and he would be one step closer in creating his own Holocron.<ref name="Rule of Two" />

==Behind the scenes==
The duel on Ambria was written and conceived by author [[Drew Karpyshyn]] for the [[2007]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''. Karpyshyn used this event to show that not all Sith fell on Russan, and to eliminate the character Hetton, thus ensuring the anonymity of the Sith.
